## 🚀 How to Install

1. Download **`QuickInspect-__VERSION__.zip`** below.
2. Unzip the folder.
3. Go to `chrome://extensions/` in Chrome.
4. Enable **Developer mode**.
5. Click **Load unpacked** and select the folder.

Updating from an earlier version: unzip over the same folder, then click the reload icon on the QuickInspect card in `chrome://extensions/`. Tabs that were already open switch to the new version when you reload them or open the popup there.
